text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $81.6K while Ethereum remains flat at $2.4K, suggesting consolidation at current price levels with neither asset showing conviction. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral 50 but has declined 13 points over a week, indicating a shift away from bullish sentiment despite stable prices. Bitcoin dominance at 60% and moderate volume of $69B reflect a market in pause mode, where investors appear cautious rather than capitulating or rushing in.
